name: mcp-metacritic
description: MCP server for Metacritic. Search films, shows and games, read Metascores and critic reviews with attribution. No API key required.
long_description: Search films, shows and games, read Metascores and the critic reviews behind them. No API key, no account.

tools.name: search_titles
tools.description: Find films, shows and games by title.

tools.name: get_title
tools.description: Read one entry, section by section.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Read individual critic or audience reviews, with attribution.

tools.name: browse_titles
tools.description: List by score, release date or current popularity.
